An oak maze gill ( Daedalea quercina ), found in the Bohemian Switzerland, Czech Republic.
Thick-walled maze polypore, maze-gill fungus, oak-loving maze polypore, or oak mazegill ( Fomitopsis quercina ). The former binominal name was Daedalea quercina up to 2024. Ukraine, Vinnytsia rajon.
